rows.instruction: Ensure the car is parked on level ground.
Apply the parking brake.
Place wheel chocks against the tires to prevent the car from rolling.
Locate the vehicle's designated jacking points, typically found behind the front wheels and in front of the rear wheels.
Position a floor jack under the front jacking point on one side of the car.
Raise the car slightly and place a jack stand under the jacking point on that side.
Lower the car onto the jack stand and repeat the process for the other side to secure the front of the vehicle.

rows.instruction: Place jack stands underneath the front jacking points on both sides of the car.
Lower the car down onto the front jack stands, starting at the lowest setting to maintain access to the rear.
Bring a floor jack to the rear of the car and position it under the rear jacking point.
Place a shop rag on top of the floor jack to protect the differential casing.
Lift the rear of the car and place jack stands underneath the rear jacking points.
Lower the car down onto the rear jack stands.
Adjust the jack stands to ensure the car is level, lifting the front or rear incrementally if needed.
Ensure the car is stable and the jack stands are not tipping over.
Give the car a shake to verify it is safe to get underneath.
Place wood blocks underneath each of the wheels as an extra precaution.
Slightly loosen the lug nuts before lifting the vehicle if the wheels are to be removed.
Verify access to the underside of the car for maintenance tasks.

Position a drain pan under the vehicle's transmission and remove the drain plug to empty the fluid.
